'''João José Rodrigues Tilly''' (born 30 May 1960)<ref>{{Cite web |title=João Tilly – YouTube |url=https://www.youtube.com/@JoaoTilly/ |access-date=2024-03-18 |website=www.youtube.com}}</ref> is a [[Politics of Portugal|Portuguese politician]], math teacher, and [[YouTuber]] who was elected as a member of the [[Assembly of the Republic (Portugal)|Assembly of the Republic]] following the [[2024 Portuguese legislative election|2024 legislative election]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=15 March 2024 |title=Visão {{!}} O exército de André Ventura: Quem são e o que pensam os novos deputados do Chega |url=https://visao.pt/atualidade/politica/2024-03-15-o-exercito-de-andre-ventura-quem-sao-e-o-que-pensam-os-novos-deputados-do-chega/ |access-date=2024-03-18 |website=Visão |language=pt-PT}}</ref>

== Biography ==
Tilly was born in 1960. He studied mechanical engineering and is currently a math teacher.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Biografia |url=http://www.parlamento.pt/DeputadoGP/Paginas/Biografia.aspx?BID=8596 |access-date=2024-04-02 |website=www.parlamento.pt |language=pt-PT}}</ref> He lives in [[Seia]], in the [[Guarda District]], since 1989.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Marques |first=Bianca |date=2025-01-31 |title=João Tilly e Rita Matias são candidatos às autárquicas pelo Chega |url=https://jornaleconomico.sapo.pt/noticias/joao-tilly-e-rita-matias-sao-candidatos-as-autarquicas-pelo-chega/ |access-date=2025-01-31 |website=O Jornal Económico |language=pt-PT}}</ref>

He gained popularity through his YouTube videos commenting on current politics. In his videos, João Tilly has spread [[COVID-19 vaccine misinformation and hesitancy|hesitancy about COVID-19 vaccines]] and has strongly criticized Ukraine President [[Volodymyr Zelenskyy|Volodymyr Zelensky]] after the start of the [[Russian invasion of Ukraine]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Primeiro deputado eleito pelo Chega em 2024 “atacou o Zelensky e era negacionista das vacinas”? |url=https://poligrafo.sapo.pt/fact-check/primeiro-deputado-eleito-pelo-chega-em-2024-atacou-o-zelensky-e-era-negacionista-das-vacinas/ |access-date=2026-01-30 |website=Poligrafo |language=pt-PT|date=2024-03-10}}</ref>
